about: Arteigenschaften: Grenzwerte, abgeleitete Fakten, Regeln, Teilmerkmale und ihre Kombinationen. Bedingungen lesen Messwerte, Fakten und Grenzwerte (trait_expression.py).

facts.colorselective: seeing and peak >= colorPeak and min(sight) < colorContrast * peak
facts.fine_nose: calibrated and nose and thresholds.odor <= fineNoseThreshold
facts.keen_eye: seeing and peak >= keenPeak and directions.light >= keenDirections and thresholds.light <= keenThreshold
facts.sharp_eye: seeing and peak >= sharpPeak and directions.light >= sharpDirections

rules.name: lichtempfindlich
rules.when: seeing and sensitive.light and peak >= peakShare

rules.name: Rundblick
rules.when: seeing and peak >= peakShare and directions.light < axes

rules.name: feinfühlig
rules.when: present.flow and calibrated and thresholds.flow <= threshold

rules.name: aufmerksam
rules.when: present.flow and calibrated and low < thresholds.flow <= high and directions.flow >= axes

rules.name: wundfühlig
rules.when: present.damage and calibrated and thresholds.damage <= threshold and early.damage >= earlyShare

rules.name: wehleidig
rules.when: present.damage and calibrated and low < thresholds.damage <= high and early.damage >= earlyShare

rules.name: zach
rules.when: present.damage and calibrated and late.damage >= lateShare

rules.name: kräftig
rules.when: has(body, 'propulsion') and has(body, 'mass') and body.mass > 0 and body.propulsion / body.mass >= ratio

rules.name: Mischköstler
rules.when: diet_known and shares.algae + shares.plant >= share and shares.fish + shares.egg + shares.carrion + shares.plankton + shares.worm + shares.crab + shares.mussel >= share

rules.name: Dunkelgänger
rules.when: eco_known and shadow >= share and get(ecology, 'light', 1) < light

rules.name: Sauger
rules.when: observed and diet_known and d.mouth >= suction

rules.name: Schlafhaube
rules.when: observed and d.pauses > pauses and d.travel < speed

rules.name: Treibholz
rules.when: observed and d.pauses > pauses and d.travel < speed and d.range > cells

rules.name: Gleiter
rules.when: observed and d.glides > glides and d.travel > speed

rules.name: wendig
rules.when: observed and d.turn > turn and d.range < cells

rules.name: Wirbelwind
rules.when: observed and d.turn > turn and d.travel > speed

rules.name: zappelig
rules.when: observed and d.turn > turn and d.range < cells

rules.name: umtriebig
rules.when: observed and d.range > cells and d.pauses < pauses

rules.name: sesshaft
rules.when: observed and d.range < cells and d.travel > speed

rules.name: Graser
rules.when: eco_known and meadow >= meadowShare and rooted >= rootedShare

rules.name: Nager
rules.when: diet_known and rooted >= share and bite >= force and body.blunt_teeth >= blunt

rules.name: Wühler
rules.when: eco_known and buried >= buriedShare and shares.benthic >= share

rules.name: Laichräuber
rules.when: eco_known and meadow >= meadowShare and egg_eater

rules.name: Lauerer
rules.when: hunter and observed and d.pauses > pauses and d.pulses < pulses

rules.name: Trüffelschwein
rules.when: preferred.food and bottom_dweller and shares.feed >= share

rules.name: Gourmet
rules.when: fine_nose and sensitive.intake and variety >= sources

rules.name: Maulwurf
rules.when: eco_known and buried >= buriedShare and barbels >= cells

rules.name: Passagier
rules.when: observed and d.pauses > pauses and d.travel < speed and d.range > cells and d.current >= current

rules.name: Späher
rules.when: sharp_eye and present.flow and directions.flow >= axes

rules.name: Lotse
rules.when: sensitive.flow and present.bladder_pressure and span.bladder_pressure >= spanShare

rules.name: abwehrbereit
rules.when: sensitive.touch and observed and d.defense > defense

rules.name: Igel
rules.when: sensitive.touch and body.armor >= armor and observed and d.defense > defense

rules.name: Draufgänger
rules.when: calibrated and present.damage and late.damage >= lateShare and observed and d.aggression > aggression

rules.name: Streithansl
rules.when: sensitive.touch and observed and d.aggression > aggression

rules.name: Bauchmensch
rules.when: inner_cells >= cells and inner_cells > ratio * outer_cells

rules.name: Verfolger
rules.when: hunter and observed and d.travel > speed and sharp_eye

rules.name: Schleicher
rules.when: hunter and seeing and observed and low < d.travel < high and d.pauses < pauses

rules.name: Pirat
rules.when: hunter and observed and d.range > cells

rules.name: Wiesel
rules.when: has(body, 'radius') and radius < high and observed and d.turn > turn

rules.name: bissig
rules.when: bite >= force and observed and d.aggression > aggression

rules.name: Panzer
rules.when: body.armor >= armor and observed and d.defense > defense

rules.name: Kundschafter
rules.when: seeing and nose and senses.light >= cells

rules.name: Navigator
rules.when: seeing and present.bladder_pressure and span.bladder_pressure >= spanShare

rules.name: Beobachter
rules.when: seeing and present.flow and not sharp_eye

rules.name: Prüfer
rules.when: seeing and present.touch and directions.touch >= axes

rules.name: Angler
rules.when: present.flow and present.intake and diet_known and observed and shares.feed >= share and d.travel < speed

rules.name: Gründler
rules.when: present.touch and present.intake and bottom_dweller and shares.feed + shares.benthic >= share

rules.name: Strawanzer
rules.when: nose and present.bladder_pressure and observed and d.range > cells

rules.name: Kenner
rules.when: seeing and sight.red >= red and sensitive.intake and diet_known and shares.feed >= share

rules.name: Dickhäuter
rules.when: present.touch and present.damage and late.touch >= lateShare and late.damage >= lateShare

rules.name: Allrounder
rules.when: sum(present) >= sensesCount and present.light + present.odor + present.flow + present.touch >= outer

open_water.when: eco_known and rock < rockShare and meadow < meadowShare and buried < buriedShare

local.when: observed and d.range < cells and d.travel > speed

bands.read: part(get(body, 'internal', None), sum(senses)) if has(body, 'senses') else None
d.travel * speedScale if observed else None
d.turn * turnScale if observed else None
get(ecology, 'buried', None) if eco_known else None
get(ecology, 'light', None) if eco_known else None
brightness(d.red, d.green, d.blue) if observed else None
saturation(d.red, d.green, d.blue) if observed and brightness(d.red, d.green, d.blue) > grayBrightness else None
(fullTurn * hue(d.red, d.green, d.blue) + hueShift) % fullTurn if observed and saturation(d.red, d.green, d.blue) >= hueSaturation and brightness(d.red, d.green, d.blue) > hueBrightness else None
